answer.answer: Pooling all literature values gives only a weak negative Spearman correlation (rho ≈ -0.14) between log(size) and zeta potential, meaning size is not a strong driver of surface charge. Zeta is dominated instead by surface chemistry (plain/carboxyl/amine) and suspension medium (DI water vs. salts vs. culture medium), which swamp any size-related trend.
